mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops >0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% y-o-y, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO y-o-y growth < -2% but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 20% y-o-y, it signals an overextended housing market that will soon reverse, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth > 20% but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 1% y-o-y, it signals a weakening labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS y-o-y growth < -1% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth slows by more than 2% y-o-y, it signals a consumer-led economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a flattening yield curve.
failure_condition: RSAFS y-o-y growth < -2% and CPIAUCSL flattens, but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening of the yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals impending economic weakness that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by falling industrial production.
failure_condition: 10y-2y spread < 1% and INDPRO y-o-y growth < 2%, but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.
